title: Masking Mod
description: This mod adds a custom enchant for helmets that protect you from looking at Enderman.
body:
# JubeTweaks Masking Mod!

In this mod I added a custom enchantment for helmets to protect you from making Endermen angry when you look at them. Just like wearing a pumpkin, except on your armour!

All enchants can be found in the Enchanting Table OR from Librarian Villagers!

Thank you so much for downloading :3
